style_notes: Analog 35mm film photography, Kodak Portra 400 grain structure, heavily muted desaturated palette. Abstract and conceptual — never literal, never illustrative. No people, no faces, no obvious religious iconography. Evoke emotional and theological truth through texture, light, shadow, and negative space alone. Think Alabaster Books meets Kinfolk magazine: spare, intimate, unhurried. Objects minimal or absent. Light does the storytelling.
color_palette: Warm wood, dust gold, deep interior shadow, indigo, ash blue, faded gold, cream wool, bleached linen, stone, pale dawn — heavily desaturated with analog film warmth

images.title: You Have Searched Me
images.concept: Deep knowledge — every grain visible in the light, no hiding in the surface
images.imageAlt: A single shaft of late afternoon light entering through a small window onto worn wooden interior, dust motes visible in the beam

images.title: Where Can I Go
images.concept: Omnipresence across heights and depths and dawn and night — even the darkness is light
images.imageAlt: A wide horizon at dusk where the deep blue-violet of night meets the last pale light of day in a perfectly horizontal band

images.title: Search Me
